notes: CardDemo's credit card list (transaction CCLI, program COCRDLIC): seven cards a page browsed from CARDDAT (STARTBR GTEQ / READNEXT, ENDBR), filtered by an optional 11-digit account and 16-digit card number typed on the screen; an eighth READNEXT probes for a next page; PF8 / PF7 page forward from the probed card and back (READPREV) from the page's first; an 'S' or 'U' beside a row XCTLs to the card view (COCRDSLC) or update (COCRDUPC) with that row's account and card; PF3 (or PF15) XCTLs to the main menu; any other key acts as ENTER. The page state and the rows shown travel in the COMMAREA after CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, its rows as WS-ALL-ROWS); the scenarios that start mid-conversation set it as the program itself leaves it. Every file is the corpus's own data, but for `select-invalid-code-on-a-page-ending-at-the-last-card`'s own seed/carddata-7.txt (its first seven cards), so a page can end on the file's last record (50 cards, one per account: seven full pages and an eighth of one card). Defects of the original the scenarios show: a filtered browse starts at the current page's first card, not the file's start, so a card earlier in the file is never found (account-filter-from-page-3-misses-earlier-cards), and once a card filter has been used, clearing it lists from that card (enter-after-clearing-the-card-filter); a selection error browses from a key nothing set (spaces), so page 1's rows come back under the current page number (select-invalid-code-on-page-2); PF7 reports 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY' on arriving at page 1, and a filtered PF7 that runs off the start of the file shows an empty page 1 though a matching card exists; the STARTBR's RESP is never tested, so a file that is not open ends in the ENDBR (no RESP) abending with INVREQ; the PF3 / re-entry restart INITIALIZEs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA, user id included. Latent, not reachable with this data: WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM is PIC 9(1), so a tenth page would number 0. scenarios.name: select-invalid-code-on-a-page-ending-at-the-last-card
scenarios.why: a selection error (code 'X') with valid filters, on a file of exactly seven cards (seed/carddata-7.txt): the look-ahead READNEXT after the seventh card ends the file while the error message is already on, so the end-of-file arm has no message to set

scenarios.name: enter-on-page-3-relists-page-3
scenarios.why: WHEN OTHER browses from the page's first card (WS-CA-FIRST-CARD-NUM), so the page is shown again

scenarios.name: account-filter
scenarios.why: every card is read and filtered; the one card of account 35 is listed, ENDFILE -> 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW'

scenarios.name: account-filter-not-numeric
scenarios.why: INPUT-ERROR with the account flag not OK: no browse, the rows the COMMAREA carries are shown protected

scenarios.name: account-filter-short
scenarios.why: '35' and nine spaces is not NUMERIC: the filter must be typed as all 11 digits

scenarios.name: account-filter-matches-no-card
scenarios.why: ENDFILE on page 1 with no row -> 'NO RECORDS FOUND FOR THIS SEARCH CONDITION.'

scenarios.name: account-filter-from-page-3-misses-earlier-cards
scenarios.why: the filtered browse starts at the current page's first card, not the file's: account 50's card (0500024453765740, page 1) is never read, so the list is empty with 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW'

scenarios.name: enter-after-clearing-the-card-filter
scenarios.why: the card filter left that card as the page's first: with the filter erased the list runs from it, not from the start -- cards 44-50 as page 1, and the look-ahead READNEXT meets ENDFILE

scenarios.name: both-filters-disagree
scenarios.why: card 4011500891777367 belongs to account 13: no card passes both filters

scenarios.name: both-filters-not-numeric
scenarios.why: both fields red; the card message is not set because the account message already is

scenarios.name: pf8-to-the-last-page
scenarios.why: page 8 holds the 50th card alone; ENDFILE clears the next-page flag and marks the last page shown

scenarios.name: pf8-at-the-last-page
scenarios.why: no next page and the last page already shown: WHEN OTHER relists it, 'NO MORE PAGES TO DISPLAY'

scenarios.name: pf8-at-the-last-page-after-enter
scenarios.why: the last-page flag was reset by a key other than PF8 (ENTER on page 8 leaves it 9), so this PF8 relists the page and only marks it shown: the browse's 'NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW', not 'NO MORE PAGES'

scenarios.name: pf20-acts-as-pf8
scenarios.why: YYYY-STORE-PFKEY maps PF13-PF24 onto PF1-PF12

scenarios.name: pf7-back-to-the-first-page
scenarios.why: page 1 is shown with 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY': 1400 tests CA-FIRST-PAGE after the page number was already decremented

scenarios.name: pf7-at-the-first-page
scenarios.why: already on page 1: relisted from its first card, 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY'

scenarios.name: pf7-with-account-filter-runs-off-the-top
scenarios.why: READPREV skips every earlier card (none is account 35) and meets ENDFILE at the start of the file, handled as a file error; with the page number now 1 that message is replaced by 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY': an empty page 1, though account 35's card exists

scenarios.name: select-view
scenarios.why: XCTL COCRDSLC with the third row's account and card number

scenarios.name: select-update
scenarios.why: XCTL COCRDUPC with the fifth row's account and card number

scenarios.name: select-lowercase-is-invalid
scenarios.why: only 'S' and 'U' are actions: lowercase is 'INVALID ACTION CODE', both rows red

scenarios.name: select-invalid-code-on-page-2
scenarios.why: the INPUT-ERROR branch browses from WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM, which nothing set (INITIALIZEd to spaces): the rows of page 1 come back under page number 2, with the 'X' beside the fourth

scenarios.name: select-two-and-an-invalid-code
scenarios.why: the 'only one record' message stands; the 'X' row is marked red too but its message is not set

scenarios.name: account-filter-with-an-invalid-code
scenarios.why: a selection error with valid filters still browses (filtered, from the file's start): one row, and ENDFILE leaves 'INVALID ACTION CODE' in place

scenarios.name: select-two-rows
scenarios.why: 'PLEASE SELECT ONLY ONE RECORD TO VIEW OR UPDATE', both selections red

scenarios.name: pf3-xctl-fails
scenarios.why: #5401: XCTL COMEN01C answers PGMIDERR RESP2 3 (the program could not be loaded, IBM CICS TS XCTL conditions); the source has no RESP, so CICS abends the task and no screen or COMMAREA is returned

scenarios.name: pf3-on-first-entry-lists
scenarios.why: PF3 leaves only when the COMMAREA is this program's own: from the menu WHEN PFK03 lists page 1

scenarios.name: back-from-card-view
scenarios.why: COCRDSLC's PF3 XCTLs back with only CARDDEMO-COMMAREA: a fresh start on page 1

scenarios.name: reenter-context-from-another-program
scenarios.why: WHEN CDEMO-PGM-REENTER from another program INITIALIZEs CARDDEMO-COMMAREA -- the user id too -- and lists page 1 (no CardDemo program XCTLs here with context 1; the branch is reached only so)

scenarios.name: pf10-with-a-selection-views
scenarios.why: an invalid key becomes ENTER, and ENTER with 'S' XCTLs to the card view

faults.why: the STARTBR's RESP is never tested: the READNEXT that follows finds no browse
17 on the 3rd READNEXT -> 'File Error: READ on CARDDAT returned RESP 17' with two rows
17 on the READNEXT past the 7th row (the next-page probe): seven rows and the file error
17 on the first READPREV: GO TO the exit (which ENDBRs), no rows
17 on the 4th READPREV: rows 7 and 6 filled from the bottom, the rest empty

scenarios.name: enter-with-page-number-zero
scenarios.why: #4602: WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM 0 in the COMMAREA (PIC 9(1): what ADD +1 leaves after page 9): WHEN OTHER relists from the first card, and the first row read takes IF WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM = 0 (line 1177) true, page 1

scenarios.name: pf8-at-the-last-page-flag-neither-shown-nor-not
scenarios.why: #4602: WS-CA-LAST-PAGE-DISPLAYED 5, neither CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN (0) nor CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN (9): PF8 with no next page relists the last page and 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE takes the PF8 / no-next-page arm with IF CA-LAST-PAGE-NOT-SHOWN (line 913) false

scenarios.name: pf8-next-page-carries-return-flag
scenarios.why: #5401 (mutation survivor 62c41cc4a8): a non-blank WS-RETURN-FLAG in the caller's COMMAREA is carried to the output COMMAREA; no other scenario sets it

scenarios.name: pf3-from-menu-stale-first-card-faulting-carddat

faults.why: 17 on the first READNEXT: no row is read, so CA-FIRST-CARD-ACCT-ID stays as INITIALIZE left it

scenarios.why: #5401 (mutation survivor 6fef123a15): entered from the menu, the program INITIALIZEs its COMMAREA, so the stale first-card account id (41) must come back 0 when the browse reads no row

scenarios.name: full-commarea-length
scenarios.why: #5401 (EIBCALEN, mutation survivors): the caller states EIBCALEN as the whole COMMAREA. No shorter length can be stated: the program moves DFHCOMMAREA past 160 bytes unconditionally, a reference past EIBCALEN the oracle refuses (X23)

scenarios.name: select-view-xctl-fails
scenarios.why: #5401: XCTL COCRDSLC answers PGMIDERR RESP2 3 (the program could not be loaded, IBM CICS TS XCTL conditions); the source has no RESP, so CICS abends the task and no screen or COMMAREA is returned

scenarios.name: select-update-xctl-fails
scenarios.why: #5401: XCTL COCRDUPC answers PGMIDERR RESP2 3 (the program could not be loaded, IBM CICS TS XCTL conditions); the source has no RESP, so CICS abends the task and no screen or COMMAREA is returned

scenarios.name: pf8-with-card-filter-skips-to-the-matching-card
scenarios.why: PF8 from the 8th card with a valid 16-digit card filter (the ENTER form is refused by X8): 2220 takes the numeric branch, 9500 excludes every card but 4011500891777367 and the browse runs to ENDFILE

scenarios.name: pf8-with-all-zeros-account-filter
scenarios.why: #5401 (mutation survivor 1761ccd4aa): PF8 with an account filter of eleven zeros (the ENTER form is refused by X8): 2210 treats a numeric zero like a blank filter, so the account id is 0 and no filter applies

scenarios.name: pf8-with-all-zeros-card-filter
scenarios.why: #5401 (mutation survivor d9ff5e4dbc): PF8 with a card filter of sixteen zeros (the ENTER form is refused by X8): 2220 treats a numeric zero like a blank filter, so the card number is 0 and no filter applies

scenarios.name: pf8-endbr-invreq

faults.why: the ENDBR after the page is read has no RESP: INVREQ takes the default action, an abend

scenarios.why: #5401 (mutation survivor fc564b048f): the ENDBR that closes the browse answers INVREQ on a PF8 page (the ENTER form is refused by X8); the source has no RESP, so CICS abends the task

scenarios.name: pf7-endbr-invreq

faults.why: the ENDBR after the page is read has no RESP: INVREQ takes the default action, an abend

scenarios.why: #5401 (mutation survivor fc564b048f): the ENDBR that closes the backward browse answers INVREQ on a PF7 page; the source has no RESP, so CICS abends the task

scenarios.name: pf8-page-ends-exactly-on-the-last-card
scenarios.why: PF8 from the 44th card: the seven rows are 44..50 so the look-ahead READNEXT after the 7th row hits ENDFILE with no earlier message ('NO MORE RECORDS TO SHOW')

scenarios.name: pf8-page-number-zero-no-next-page
scenarios.why: PF8 with no next page falls to WHEN OTHER (no ADD 1), so the first row read finds WS-CA-SCREEN-NUM still 0 and bumps it to 1

scenarios.name: pf7-at-the-first-page-account-filter-matches-nothing
scenarios.why: PF7 on page 1 relists from the first card; an account filter that matches no card reaches ENDFILE on page 1 with no row: NO-RECORDS-FOUND

scenarios.name: no-commarea-pf7
scenarios.why: no COMMAREA with PF7 (the ENTER form is refused by X8): 0000-MAIN initialises page 1 and PF7 on the first page relists it, so 1300 skips the filter setup

scenarios.name: pf8-back-from-card-view-keeps-the-selected-ids
scenarios.why: PF8 arriving from COCRDSLC with its account and card still in the COMMAREA: the screen is not received, so neither filter is set and 1300 echoes CDEMO-ACCT-ID and CDEMO-CARD-NUM
